visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a black baseball cap backwards and a black graphic T-shirt with Godzilla prints, stands in front of a bright yellow vending machine. He points at the machine's menu while looking directly at the camera with a curious expression. The lighting is bright natural daylight in an outdoor urban setting. (2) The camera zooms in on the vending machine's interface, which features a grid of twelve numbered options, each paired with a unique Pokémon illustration like Eevee, Gengar, and Snorlax. The background of the machine is yellow with Pokéball patterns, and a small digital screen displays payment instructions near a card reader. (3) The man gestures toward the digital screen which shows a numeric keypad. He holds a small orange card with a cartoon face in his right hand, preparing to pay. He looks at the machine and then back at the camera, explaining the situation with active facial movements. (4) The man's hand reaches out and presses the number '1' and then '0' on the touchscreen, selecting the 'Courage' option. He then moves his orange card toward the sensor area below the screen. The machine's lights flicker slightly during the transaction process. (5) A close-up shot shows the man struggling to align the card with the reader. His hand moves back and forth tentatively before successfully tapping the sensor. The screen changes to show a processing message. He looks slightly frustrated but maintains a playful demeanor. (6) The camera follows the man's hand as he reaches into the bottom collection bin of the machine. He pulls out a white plastic bottle with blue labeling. The screen above indicates the transaction is successful. (7) The man holds the bottle—a Calpis Water—up to the camera lens. He has a surprised and amused smile, squinting his eyes and sticking his tongue out briefly. He looks at the bottle and then at the 'Courage' label on the machine, emphasizing the unexpected result.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a single male voice speaking Mandarin in a casual, conversational tone. The pitch is moderate and the pace is natural. There is a very faint background hum of city traffic, suggesting an outdoor urban environment. (2) A sharp electronic 'beep' sounds as a digital interaction occurs. Immediately, high-tempo Japanese pop music with bright synthesized melodies and a driving 4/4 drum beat swells in the background. The man's voice continues, rising in pitch as he expresses curiosity. (3) A series of rapid digital 'clicks' represent touchscreen buttons being pressed. The background music remains constant, featuring a high-pitched female vocal in Japanese. The man's vocal arousal increases, his tone becoming more animated as he describes his selection. (4) A distinct mechanical 'clunk' and a metallic sliding sound indicate an object dropping into a bin. This is followed by a short digital notification chime. The background music continues at a consistent tempo. (5) The man's voice breaks into a light laugh. He speaks with a playful, questioning intonation, emphasizing certain syllables. The music remains steady, providing an upbeat, energetic atmosphere until the track fades slightly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a humorous and quirky experience of discovering a 'blind box' style Pokémon vending machine and to show the unexpected result of choosing 'Courage'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands like Pokémon and Calpis are prominent, the video is styled as a personal discovery vlog rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses popular Pokémon IP and a 'mystery shop' concept to engage viewers. The humor stems from the juxtaposition of an abstract concept like 'Courage' with a common beverage.
